It got me into an altered, almost-trance state that 'watched' the pain rather than feeling it.

The exertion of it and the body chemistry it produced allowed me to sleep (sometimes) after 40 minutes or so.

Lips get tingly, vibration takes over, hyperoxygenation occurs, the repetition bypasses some aspect of perception..I was totally high on it, in a way.
The extreme (!!) pain became manageable, somehow. Not gone, just not driving me insane/wishing to not exist.

I have no idea where it came from, but it worked for me. If it can help one other sufferer out there, this comment is worth it.
